tokens.name: ns-bg
tokens.usage: The ground of every page.

tokens.usage: Bands (ns-band), cards, panels, the Initiatives menu, the radio bar.

tokens.name: ns-raised
tokens.usage: Hover fill: outline buttons, menu rows.

tokens.name: ns-line
tokens.usage: Every 1px rule and the border of cards, panels and tiles.

tokens.name: ns-line-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered card and tile borders; the dashed 'to be decided' box.

tokens.name: ns-text
tokens.usage: Display type, headings, links, solid buttons' fill. 18:1 on ns-bg.

tokens.name: ns-soft
tokens.usage: Reading copy: ledes, prose, card and panel text. 13:1 on ns-bg.

tokens.name: ns-muted
tokens.usage: Kickers, footer links, secondary values. 8.6:1 on ns-bg.

tokens.name: ns-dim
tokens.usage: Labels, metadata, addresses, the footer's small print. 5.5:1 on ns-bg, 5:1 on ns-band: the lowest text goes.

tokens.name: ns-pink
tokens.usage: Now: the Academy's current seminar, executed proposals, the start of the gradient. 6.5:1 on ns-bg.

tokens.name: ns-cyan
tokens.usage: Ahead and interactive: hover, focus ring, planned timeline items, passed proposals, Play's opening. 10:1 on ns-bg.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace
